adverseMoves.summary: Second-ranked 20th Central Committee alternate was bypassed at both the July 2024 Third Plenum and October 2025 Fourth Plenum. Later appearance evidence weakens detention or removal hypotheses but does not erase the Party-selection anomaly. Retain outside the positive forecast until a formal senior appointment, 21st Congress elevation, or authoritative explanation resolves the bypass.

20th Central Committee alternate was bypassed during vacancy filling at the 2025 Fourth Plenum. The event is a discrete Party-selection warning, not proof of investigation or removal. Retain outside the positive forecast until a formal appointment, 21st Congress elevation, or authoritative explanation resolves the bypass.

systemSources.title: 中央军委政治工作部领导就现役军官管理暂行条例及配套法规答记者问
supports: Promotion qualifications were hardened around political standards and warfighting ability
Regular, early, exceptional, and out-of-sequence appointment conditions are distinct

systemSources.title: 关于加强军队高级干部教育管理监督的若干措施

doesNotSupport: Which individual officers passed review or how the measures are weighted in a specific appointment

gaps.title: 2026 senior-cadre course roster, evaluations, and exits
gaps.whyItMatters: May reveal the hidden political-clearance pool for the 2027 Party slate
gaps.evidenceNeeded: Student roster, branch-site attendance, sixteen closing speakers, early exits, remediation, post-course assignments
gaps.searchLane: NDU and branch sites, PLA Daily local editions, video links, post-course appointment reports
gaps.doNotAssume: public prominence, attendance by a role model, or post-course silence proves student status or clearance
billetPools: Party CMC and senior principal pool

gaps.title: Eligible-loser denominator for each Party cycle
gaps.whyItMatters: Without the risk set, winner-route prevalence cannot become selection odds or route lift
gaps.evidenceNeeded: Frozen full-general, principal, deputy-principal, Party-member, new three-star, lateral, retirement, purge, and unresolved cohorts
gaps.searchLane: Official rosters and promotions, Jost/Mattingly legacy data, annual personnel directories, manual 2017-26 continuation
gaps.doNotAssume: P(route | winner) equals P(winner | route), or that pre-purge and post-purge selection regimes are stable
billetPools: service, theater, central, and political principals

gaps.title: Candidate-specific command behavior and output attribution
gaps.whyItMatters: Unit output cannot be converted into an officer performance grade without a documented causal link
gaps.evidenceNeeded: Exercise-director titles, signed after-action lessons, award citations, implementation records, repeated cross-role behavior
gaps.searchLane: PLA Daily bylines, exercise reporting, unit histories, military journals, award and training records
gaps.doNotAssume: attendance, command incumbency, or a unit press release proves personal design, execution, learning, or success

gaps.title: Dated co-service networks and patronage denominator
gaps.whyItMatters: Broad region, academy, and hometown labels produce faction folklore rather than causal promotion evidence
gaps.evidenceNeeded: Exact overlap dates, hierarchy, shared scarce program, pre-promotion direction, independent sources, eligible-peer baseline
gaps.searchLane: Official biographies, unit rosters, course lists, promotion chronology, serious personnel scholarship
gaps.doNotAssume: co-service, a shared ceremony, or a link to a purged officer establishes sponsorship, alliance, guilt, or protection

gaps.title: Mutable-source snapshots and event-expectancy baselines
gaps.whyItMatters: Live pages change, reprints are correlated, and absences only matter when event coverage and attendance expectations are known
gaps.evidenceNeeded: Retrieved-at time, snapshot hash, origin ID, supersession link, event-family attendance rates, peer controls, explanations
gaps.searchLane: Weekly Xinhua/MOD/81.cn archiving and recurring-event historical reconstruction
gaps.doNotAssume: multiple URLs are independent, a current mutable page proves a historical state, or one roster omission proves removal

gaps.title: Service/theater Party committees and staff-system continuity
gaps.whyItMatters: The PLA is dual-command and committee-led; a named commander is not the whole decision system
gaps.evidenceNeeded: Military principal, political principal, Party secretary/deputy secretary, standing committee, staff chief, delegated authority
gaps.searchLane: Party committee meetings, political-work regulations, exact title-bearing reports, recurring command events
gaps.doNotAssume: the political commissar is automatically Party secretary, a vacant public title means an absent internal order, or one person controls every task
